description: A customizable, data-driven CRM platform built for agentic revenue and modern GTM teams.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public apps, and private app access tokens (bearer tokens) for workspace-specific integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free tier account and obtain credentials or private app tokens instantly self-serve.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering core objects (people, companies, deals), lists, attributes, webhooks, and SQL access on upper tiers.
mcp_notes: Official Attio MCP server provided by the vendor to connect AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT directly to workspaces.
rationale: Attio features a fully documented public REST API, self-serve free plan access, and an official MCP server.
